```yaml
name: Changes Filter

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  detect-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      should_run_tests: ${{ steps.detect_changes.outputs.should_run_tests }}
      should_run_coverage: ${{ steps.detect_changes.outputs.should_run_coverage }}
      should_run_security_scans: ${{ steps.detect_changes.outputs.should_run_security_scans }}
      should_run_validation: ${{ steps.detect_changes.outputs.should_run_validation }}
      should_run_dead_code_detection: ${{ steps.detect_changes.outputs.should_run_dead_code_detection }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Detect changes
        id: detect_changes
        run: |
          # Define patterns for different types of files
          TEST_FILES="src/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
          COVERAGE_FILES="coverage/**/*"
          SECURITY_FILES="package-lock.json yarn.lock package.json"
          VALIDATION_FILES="docs/**/* README.md"
          DEAD_CODE_FILES="src/**/*.ts"

          # Check if any files match the patterns
          should_run_tests=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "$TEST_FILES" && echo "true" || echo "false")
          should_run_coverage=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "$COVERAGE_FILES" && echo "true" || echo "false")
          should_run_security_scans=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "$SECURITY_FILES" && echo "true" || echo "false")
          should_run_validation=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "$VALIDATION_FILES" && echo "true" || echo "false")
          should_run_dead_code_detection=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E "$DEAD_CODE_FILES" && echo "true" || echo "false")

          # Output results
          echo "::set-output name=should_run_tests::$should_run_tests"
          echo "::set-output name=should_run_coverage::$should_run_coverage"
          echo "::set-output name=should_run_security_scans::$should_run_security_scans"
          echo "::set-output name=should_run_validation::$should_run_validation"
          echo "::set-output name=should_run_dead_code_detection::$should_run_dead_code_detection"

  ci:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should_run_tests == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  coverage:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should_run_coverage == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Generate coverage report
        run: nyc npm test

  security:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should_run_security_scans == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run dependency review
        run: npm run dependency-review

      - name: Run npm audit
        run: npm audit

      - name: Run socket security scan
        run: npm run socket-security

  validation:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should_run_validation == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run validation report
        run: npm run validate

  dead-code-detection:
    needs: detect-changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: needs.detect-changes.outputs.should_run_dead_code_detection == 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run dead code detection
        run: npm run check-dead-code
```
